answer: Price the attacker out of the game and the honest applicant stays in it. Chartered ship captain licence with port state attestation does that by charging in years: a licence port officers renew after inspection audits. The raven of the charge is the waiting — the record accrues one entry at a time, and no compute can hurry it. Each entry names a keeper who can be telephoned, and the dune of a forgery is the hundred phone calls that must all tell the same lie. The yarrow that ends the test is the first call that does not.
